# What api-diff's focus job (and api-probe with [api-focus]) prints straight into its log; the workflows list the kinds
# of line. "datadiff <path>" lines are printed by api-diff's overrides job, 26.3's file against 26.4's.
# Recipes: where 26.4 reads recipe files, to change them by rule as they load (families for groups, cheaper stairs,
# slabs and pressure plates) instead of replacing vanilla's files.
calls net.minecraft.world.item.crafting.RecipeManager ^prepare$|^apply$|^<init>$
member net.minecraft.world.item.crafting.RecipeManager .
calls net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.SimpleJsonResourceReloadListener ^scanDirectory$
member net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.SimpleJsonResourceReloadListener scanDirectory
member net.minecraft.world.item.crafting.Recipe CODEC
find BasePressurePlateBlock
member net.minecraft.core.registries.Registries RECIPE
